exposure: First trimester serum placental growth factor (PIGF)
outcome: Association between PIGF and placenta accreta
cohort: 177 pregnant females: 35 with placenta previa-accreta, 30 with non-adherent placenta previa, and 112 age- and BMI-matched healthy controls
finding: Increased first trimester serum PIGF was significantly positively associated with placenta accreta, suggesting its potential role in identifying high-risk pregnancies.
gest_age: First trimester (specific gestational week at time of blood sampling was adjusted for in the analysis)
